stories.headline: China steps up Middle East diplomacy with Iran and Oman meetings
stories.description: Beijing urges dialogue on US-Iran war, sends envoy to Gulf as Xi hosts first Omani head of state visit since 1978.

stories.headline: Violence in northern Ethiopia pushing health system towards collapse: WHO
stories.description: Renewed fighting between rebels from northern Tigray and the government in Addis Ababa has shattered 2022 peace deal.

stories.headline: Lobster industry caught in Maine’s political headwinds before US midterms
stories.description: Senator Susan Collins and Democratic challenger Troy Jackson clash over tariffs and their impact on Maine’s economy.

stories.headline: Displaced in Hebron: Picking up pieces after Israeli siege
stories.description: Displaced Hebron families return to damaged homes, left to pick up scattered pieces of their lives after Israeli siege.

stories.headline: Wizz Air flight from Luton in emergency landing after bomb threat
stories.description: A Hungarian fighter jet escorted the aircraft to Budapest after the threat was received mid-air.
